tools.name: start_quiz
tools.description: Starts one round of the Awwab Knowledge quiz on Islam: five questions in the chosen language, on an optional topic such as the prophets, the Qur'an, the Prophet's life, worship or Islamic history. tools.description: Grades one answer from a start_quiz round. Returns whether it is correct, the correct answer, the explanation, its sources, the running score and the quiz_id for the next answer; after the last question it also returns the final score.
